# Confab

> Confab is an unofficial, open source desktop client for Google Chat and Google Workspace, built with Tauri 2, Rust and React 19. It is not affiliated with Google.

macOS is the only platform tested so far. Web, Linux and Windows are planned. Setup needs a Google Workspace Business or Enterprise organisation and a Google Cloud project. Licensed under MIT.

## Docs

- [Website](https://arunjayakumar01.github.io/confab/): product overview and FAQ
- [README](https://github.com/arunjayakumar01/confab/blob/main/README.md): overview, setup, roadmap and FAQ
- [Features](https://github.com/arunjayakumar01/confab/blob/main/docs/FEATURES.md): spaces, threads, huddles, calendar, tasks, notes and file previews
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/arunjayakumar01/confab/blob/main/docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): common setup and runtime problems
- [Architecture](https://github.com/arunjayakumar01/confab/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): API tables, relay protocol and app commands
